SELECT 'eligible' k, count(*) n FROM elig

WITH grp AS (
  SELECT member_id, 'holdout' g FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15
  UNION SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15
),
mem AS (SELECT member_id, tier, home_store_id, join_date FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to),
sp AS (
  SELECT m.member_id,
    sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) camp,
    sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2025-11-23' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) pre
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key)
  WHERE NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2025-11-30' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT g.g, mem.tier, count(*) members, round(avg(coalesce(sp.camp,0)),4) avg_camp, round(avg(coalesce(sp.pre,0)),4) avg_pre
FROM grp g LEFT JOIN mem USING(member_id) LEFT JOIN sp USING(member_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT member_id, 'holdout' g FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15
  UNION SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15
),
lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.staff_purchase_flag staff, f.net_amount, coalesce(r.refund_net,0) refund
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key)
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r USING(sales_line_id)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30'
),
per AS (
  SELECT g.g, g.member_id,
    coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN net_amount END),0) gross_excl_staff,
    coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN net_amount-refund END),0) netret_excl_staff,
    coalesce(sum(net_amount),0) gross_incl_staff,
    coalesce(sum(net_amount-refund),0) netret_incl_staff
  FROM grp g LEFT JOIN lines l USING(member_id) GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT g, count(*) n, round(avg(gross_excl_staff),4) a1, round(avg(netret_excl_staff),4) a2, round(avg(gross_incl_staff),4) a3, round(avg(netret_incl_staff),4) a4 FROM per GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

WITH grp AS (
  SELECT member_id, 'holdout' AS grp FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1),
spend AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, sum(f.net_amount - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) AS net_spend
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  GROUP BY 1
),
per_group AS (
  SELECT g.grp, count(*) AS members, avg(coalesce(s.net_spend, 0)) AS avg_spend
  FROM grp g LEFT JOIN spend s USING (member_id) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name,
  round(max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'targeted'), 2) AS avg_spend_per_targeted_member_eur,
  round(max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'holdout'), 2) AS avg_spend_per_held_out_member_eur,
  round(max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'targeted') - max(avg_spend) FILTER (WHERE grp = 'holdout'), 2) AS uplift_eur,
  max(members) FILTER (WHERE grp='targeted') tn, max(members) FILTER (WHERE grp='holdout') hn
FROM per_group
